description_en: Queries a list of data catalogs in a data lake
description_zh: 调用此API可以获取数据湖的数据目录列表
name: ListDataLakeCatalog

parameters.help_en: The region where the data lake resides
parameters.name: data_region

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used to search for catalogs
parameters.help_zh: 搜索数据库目录名称的关键字
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to query the ID of the tenant
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid
